options.name: Low national business competitiveness
options.desc: National businesses have trouble being competitive within the country's borders even with government subsidies.

options.name: Average national business competitiveness
options.desc: National businesses can make it out on the national market but need subsidies to operate on the global market.

options.name: High national business competitiveness
options.desc: National businesses can compete on the global market alongside the most powerful players.
